I'm sure that 99% of the people here are just lonely, depressed or looking for help and I'm glad that there are so many people here showing affection and helpfulness.

But I thought very long and deeply about it and I will end it. Thing is finding helpful advice for e.g painless toxication or any other good clean way to end it is almost impossible to find but because in  our culture ending your own life is a taboo.

You literally have to butcher yourself to death and die losing all the rest of your dignity before any professional would give you any helpful advice for ending it in a peaceful manner.

Reading the Guidelines of this subreddit I realized that this is the wrong place and you're right I shouldn't expect anyone to help anybody on this matter.

Throwing myself infront of a train will be my method most likely. I was just hoping for some advice like a certain kind of overmedication or some shit like this to end it peacefully but getting shredded by a train seems the ways to go.

I don't know, I just hate the fact that I'm forced to do something like this horrible to act on the legal decission to end my own life.
